scope: H02 first increment: limited startup recovery, read-only preservation/export, typed draft-save feedback; full restore workflow is not implemented.

observedDefects.cause: MetaStore open/required defaults failure escaped Tauri setup and terminated build before React recovery could render.
observedDefects.evidence: Source path trace lib.rs setup/build; controlled storage fixtures, not an installed startup failure injection.

observedDefects.cause: Readonly/full save errors reached the renderer as undifferentiated draft-save failure.
A missing primary database with an orphaned WAL was treated as a fresh installation and initialized an empty database.
observedDefects.evidence: storage-orphan-wal-red.txt; fixed and green in storage-orphan-material-green.txt. All files temporary.

implemented: Register non-storage states before initialization. Only storage-recovery commands are admitted while no MetaStore is ready. Notification delegate initialization is scheduled on the main thread only after MetaStore registration.
Mount StorageStartup outside DraftStartup; failures expose check/export/reveal actions without mounting the editable application.
Require a valid SQLite header and PRAGMA quick_check for an existing DB before initialization writes; refuse an existing zero-length/truncated/non-regular file rather than initializing a replacement.
Remember database observation within this process; refuse to recreate it on retry after disappearance. Remove SQLITE_OPEN_CREATE after existing-file validation to protect the subsequent open race.
Serialize retries/exports with the recovery mutex; install the store only once after a successful retry.
Use SQLite backup API for an open store; copy committed WAL data and retain malformed setting strings verbatim. Validate the snapshot with quick_check and sync its file.
When no store can be opened, copy only exact DB/-wal/-shm/-journal paths to a newly created private directory. Hash before/after/copy, reject changed or non-regular material, label files unverified.
Preserve incomplete export directory and return structured issue+partialPath. UI separately shows failure and incomplete location; old success receipt is removed at a new export attempt.
Write completion metadata under recovery.incomplete.json, sync, rename to recovery.json only after material validation, and sync directory on Unix.
Keep latest draft and previous saved snapshot after readonly/full failures; retry explicitly, never auto-send.

Presence of any exact DB/-wal/-shm/-journal path is existing recovery material. Startup and direct MetaStore open refuse a missing main DB with remaining side files. Export can preserve the remaining side files alone as unverified material; similarly named unrelated files are ignored.

uiReview.goal: Keep data-failure recovery understandable and preserve original material.
uiReview.layout: Existing light/dark grey-white tokens, bounded central card, reason first, retry/export/reveal actions, private-data copy notice and separate incomplete-copy path.
uiReview.screenshots: Not verified. Child CUA chrome/iab unavailable; parent reports local-file URL blocked by policy. This visual route was stopped without workaround.

boundaries: All DB writes and fault injections were temporary test fixtures, not daily user data. No Agent/model/account/network run, application replacement, or real-user storage manipulation.

The command gate test enumerates current registered commands and checks dispatch order; run/menu callback tests are source-boundary checks. A native Tauri recovery-mode end-to-end launch was not performed.
Readonly permission fixture ran on Unix/macOS; SQLite-full used max_page_count. No physical-disk-full, hard power-loss, or Windows runtime experiment.
Raw copied files are preservation material, not verified recoverable data. A structurally valid SQLite snapshot can still contain invalid application JSON, deliberately retained verbatim.
Missing-database refusal covers a file observed during this process. No historical ledger was added; a DB removed externally before the current process starts cannot be inferred to have existed.

Required initialization can create schema/default records before a later failure. This code never manually deletes/replaces original DB/side files; SQLite normal journal/checkpoint behavior may change side-file layout when opening/closing a readable store. Exact raw byte preservation was tested for rejected physical corruption, not arbitrary partial migration failures.
No workflow for importing a selected recovery copy or repairing corrupt draft content yet; H02 is still incomplete.
After the final 15-test and 23-test runs, only the export durability comment and this evidence file changed. Full integrated checks belong to the parent.

A directory-sync failure after manifest rename still returns Err and partialPath; recovery.json may already exist. Manifest presence alone is not a durability or restoration receipt. Directory-fsync failure and hard power loss were not injected. A later importer must re-read and validate all materials.

nextIncrementDesign.status: Proposal for parent coordination; not implemented and not an additional product acceptance gate.
nextIncrementDesign.firstClosure: For a structurally healthy DB with unreadable draft/setup records, add a startup-only selected-copy preview and explicit restore of those Farfold-owned keys. This smaller transaction can preserve all other records and avoid file replacement.
nextIncrementDesign.candidatePreparation: Open only the selected file read-only; make a consistent temporary SQLite snapshot, verify integrity/schema, then run extracted pure draft/setup parsers on the selected raw values. Do not hydrate global UI state during preview. Reject an unreadable candidate without changing current records.
nextIncrementDesign.userReview: Show the chosen copy, what will be replaced, the original-material copy location and any missing sections. Require an explicit restore action for that reviewed candidate. Never trust a manifest name alone or silently drop invalid fields.
nextIncrementDesign.backendAdmission: Only allow restore before app_drafts_ready and with no Agent work admitted. Use the existing recovery mutex/state to close the command gate during preview/apply; do not replace a live editable workspace or discard current in-memory input.
nextIncrementDesign.atomicApply: Save a verified copy of the current DB first. Restore selected raw values in one SQLite transaction; on any error leave previous values and source copies available. Reload both startup stores from confirmed data without auto-sending.
nextIncrementDesign.wholeDatabaseFollowup: Physical DB corruption needs a separately verified cold replacement path. Before implementing, establish crash-safe ownership of staged candidate, original DB and exact side files, and handling of interruption at every move. A missing main DB while such recovery materials exist must remain a recovery state. Do not introduce a conversation/event ledger, or claim raw unverified material can necessarily be repaired.
nextIncrementDesign.tests: Candidate invalid/version mismatch; preview/apply source change; readonly/full transaction rollback; concurrent restore/retry; old draft/setup state not published; interrupted material preparation; unknown result preserves original and never sends.
